description: Use when the user asks to compare lawyers from find_attorneys ("which of these is a better fit?"). Compares 2 to 5 lawyers on practice fit, location, years licensed, fees, availability, data confidence and gaps. Pass match_id to use the user's criteria. Says when prices or timing cannot be compared because the data is unknown.

match_id.description: The match_id from find_attorneys, so comparisons use the same criteria

priorities.description: What matters most, in order. Shifts ranking weights.

name: compare_attorneys
title: Compare lawyers side by side
